WarTranslated A Russian Kh-101 fell just 96 km from the Coalition of the Willing exercise site in Poland, The Telegraph reports. Analysts suggest Moscow may have wanted to test Polish air defense and NATO’s reaction, and to “warn” Poland and Europe that backing Ukraine supposedly has a price. https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2026/11/20/suspected-russian-projectile-lands-in-poland-british-troops/ Monitoring channels say a cruise missile crossed into Polish airspace this morning. Poland's army says it got word of a suspected violation by unidentified air objects and is now checking radar data. Poland's Operational Command says an object probably came down near Chmielek in Bilgoraj county, PAP reports. Online reports say CCTV caught an explosion there, about 46 km from the Ukrainian border. Polish authorities have not officially reported it. Tusk says he received reports from ministers Kosiniak-Kamysz and Kierwinski. There is no air threat for now, and services are working at the site, he says. - WarTranslated tweet

🌍 This Friday, November 20, at the official closing of the COP31 Climate Summit in Antalya, Türkiye, the European Union (EU) described the second draft of the final agreement as “unacceptable” because it removed all explicit references to the phase-out of fossil fuels and their subsidies. ⚡ The nine-page document, released by the Turkish and Australian co-chairs, replaces that commitment with a goal of increasing the share of electricity in global energy consumption to 35% by 2035—though without requiring that it come from clean sources. 🔥 EU delegates are racing against the clock to reinstate the phase-out of fossil fuels, amid clashes over climate finance and carbon capture.
